--- pagetitle: "Data" description: | A searchable catalogue of the datasets published through the openwashdata community, and of the variables inside them. editor_options: chunk_output_type: console execute: echo: false warning: false --- ::: {.cell} ::: ::: {.cell} ::: ## Data The table below lists every R data package in the openwashdata organisation. Each one comes with its own website and documentation, so the data can be reused and cited. A package has a **DOI** once it is deposited on Zenodo, which is what makes it citable and permanently archived. Of the 64 packages listed here, 32 have one. The rest are published as packages and usable today, and are waiting on a deposit. :::{.column-page} ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
